easy.statement_latex:
Write the augmented matrix for the following linear system:

$$\begin{cases} x + 2y = 0 \\ 4x - y = 18 \end{cases}$$
hints: Each row of the augmented matrix holds the coefficients of one equation, followed by its right-hand side.
Order the columns as [coefficient of $x$, coefficient of $y$, constant]. Use a vertical bar to separate coefficients from the constant.
solution_steps_latex: Stack them into the augmented matrix: $\left[\begin{array}{cc|c} 1 & 2 & 0 \\ 4 & -1 & 18 \end{array}\right]$.
